brief: Reposition Cerebelly, the neuroscience-founded baby food brand, to stand out as different and better in a crowded premium baby-food category: strike a strong emotional chord with parents, own a defensible market positioning, and give parents a guided path through the baby feeding lifecycle — without getting lost in the science-heavy product-attribute details that currently confuse new parents.
constraints: Every SKU contains a patented blend of 16 brain-supporting nutrients (8x conventional baby food) — the science must support the story, not bury it
Clarify the portfolio: parents cannot tell the veggie, bone broth, and smoothie product lines apart
Products can be bundled by age but do not have to be — age-based messaging currently confuses new parents
Leverage existing proof points: Clean Label Project Purity Award, neurosurgeon/neurobiologist founder story, organic veggie-first ingredients, no added sugar
Key competitors: Serenity Kids, Once Upon a Farm, Brainiac; the category is saturated with fruit-first, overly sweet products
audience: parents of infants and toddlers — first-time parents especially — navigating the baby feeding lifecycle, motivated by their child's development but overwhelmed by science-heavy claims and skeptical of premium baby-food marketing
